 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable u/s 376 of the IPC.
3. Vide order dated 09.02.2023, provisional bail was granted to the petitioner with a direction to file supplementary affidavit.

4. A supplementary affidavit is filed on behalf of the O.P. No.2, in which, at para-2, it is stated that husband of the informant namely Sri Dhananjay Kumar (petitioner) is keeping the O.P. No.2 i.e. the informant, in Barh P.S. Case No.309/22 with himself with full honour and dignity.
5.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.2064 of 2023(5) dt.13-09-2024 the provisional bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 09.02.2023 is hereby confirmed, in connection with Barh Thana P.S. Case No.309 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
